record.file_problem: Repository metadata, README, and file list only; code was not read or run.
record.tranche_reason: The README reports a frozen direction-based intervention and its effect on refusal-classifier outcomes, but does not specify enough about the intervention to establish that it reproduces the original method.
record.gate_note: The README reports refusal-related outcomes for a Llama 3.2 intervention. The Qwen verbosity results and screening graph concern a different behavior; mentioned earlier experiment artifacts and documentation are not new README-reported results for the claim.
record.test_reason: The README reports a direction-based activation intervention (frozen multi-layer runtime hook) on Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct and its effect on refusal rates for XSTest unsafe prompts. That bears on V1's claim that removing the direction removes refusal. The direction construction and the exact operation (projection ablation or steering) are not specified in the README, so this counts as a different-method test (T2), not a reproduction (T1).
record.authors_conclusion: Correct. The authors call this a same-environment frozen-intervention reproduction, not an independent replication. They state that the classifier result and exact replay do not establish eliminated refusal, preserved capabilities, or a universal role for the selected layers.
record.recipe_differences: Abliteration workbench/tool repo. The README describes paired-prompt direction selection and a frozen multi-layer runtime hook, but does not provide the exact intervention details needed to confirm the original recipe.
record.method_sensitivity: The README notes that classifier labels have incomplete semantic validation, 43/192 intervention responses were flagged for review, scorer input may be truncated at 512 tokens, and the automated review-fraction gate allowed a pass without completed human review.
record.problems: The README says semantic validation is incomplete, identifies a false non-refusal label, reports 43/192 intervention outputs flagged for review, and notes possible scorer truncation at 512 tokens. The prompts had prior exposure, the comparison reused the same environment, and the promotion rules were refined after earlier results rather than preregistered for the whole study. General capability preservation was not tested.
record.rows_left_out: No separate row for exact replay (292/292 outputs) because replay is not a refusal or capability outcome. The 43/192 review flags and the single audited false non-refusal are reported as scorer limitations rather than separate measurements of the claim’s predicted behavior.

untested.parts: Adding the direction to induce refusal. Broad capability preservation. Whether the direction is a harmful-minus-harmless difference-in-means, and which sites and operation were used (not stated in the README).
No refusal result from a static weight edit is reported; the Llama result uses a runtime hook. The export path exists but is not evaluated for refusal.
Not tested. A multi-layer hook and an optional low-rank subspace are mentioned, but no comparison between single-direction and multi-direction accounts is reported.

missing.what: Details of the Llama intervention: discovery prompt contrast, direction estimator, layers, site, and whether it is ablation or additive steering. Needed to judge closeness to V1's recipe.

record.verdict_notes: I removed the reader's 'supports' label on r3. A safe-control check with no new benign refusals does not test V1's ablation, induction, or capability claims. The Qwen verbosity result is about response length, not refusal, and was correctly left out. The evidence is a README with self-reported, non-peer-reviewed results, prior prompt exposure, and gates refined after earlier results.

versions.untested_parts: The README does not establish the exact difference-in-means construction or projection sites, does not report adding the direction, and does not test broad general capability preservation.
No refusal-related static weight edit result is reported; the reported intervention is a runtime hook.
No attack suppression or training against ablation is reported.
No test of affine, cone, or multiple-direction accounts is reported.
No separate measure of harmfulness judgment and refusal decision is reported.
No cross-language, model-variant, or base-to-instruct transfer test is reported.
No comparison of refusal training methods or timing is reported.

rows.subject: meta-llama/Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct
rows.operation_detail: Applied a frozen multi-layer runtime hook using the selected direction; the README does not specify the exact intervention operation or sites.

conditions.value: frozen hook; exact configuration not stated

rows.uncertainty: Paired bootstrap 95% interval for net reduction: 22.9167–36.9792 percentage points
rows.note: The reported classifier-positive rate decreased but many prompts remained positive. The README states that semantic validation is incomplete and identifies a response labeled non-refusal despite containing a refusal and supportive redirection.

rows.operation_detail: Applied the same frozen multi-layer runtime hook; exact intervention operation or sites not stated.
rows.measure: Paired transitions from refusal to non-refusal and reverse
rows.note: These are machine-scored transitions; the README reports incomplete semantic validation and 43/192 intervention responses flagged for review.
rows.check: Same evaluation as r1, re-expressed as paired transitions (59 refusal→non-refusal, 2 reverse). It is not independent of r1. The labels are machine-scored, semantic validation is incomplete, and one false non-refusal is already identified.

rows.subject: meta-llama/Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct
rows.operation_detail: Applied the same frozen multi-layer runtime hook; exact intervention operation or sites not stated.
rows.measure: Safe-control classifier positives and new benign refusal labels
rows.value: 2 classifier positives; zero new benign refusal labels
rows.note: This checks safe controls only, not general model capability.
rows.check: This is a safe-prompt control: classifier positives went 4→2 with no new benign refusals. It does not show refusal removed on harmful prompts, refusal induced, or general capability kept, so it cannot confirm V1's effect. It only shows that the hook did not add refusals on 100 safe prompts.

relationships.condition: Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct, frozen multi-layer hook, 192 XSTest unsafe prompts, machine refusal classifier
relationships.reason: Classifier refusal fell only from 83.3% to 53.6% (net −29.7 pts), so most refusals remained. Semantic validation is incomplete and one false non-refusal was found (r1, r2).
relationships.display_finding: Classifier refusal fell from 83.3% to 53.6%, a 29.7-point reduction, with one apparent non-refusal subsequently identified as a false classification.

source_check.scope: Only the listed rows, labels and statements were checked; presence is not whole-study approval.
